Rate Text: A fee paid to crew members who use their basic laptop / desktop for work-related tasks, compensating for equipment wear and tear. This rate will be set by the production and should be equal across departments. If you have computer equipment of high value, you should claim ‘Specialist Kit Rental’ at a higher rate.
Source Notes: Allowance/kit rate, not labour rate.

Rate Text: A fee paid to crew members, to cover the costs of using their personal phone for work requirement, including calls, data usage etc.
Source Notes: Allowance/kit rate, not labour rate.

Rate Text: A fee paid to crew, to cover the costs associated with using a personal vehicle for work purposes. In addition to this fee, fuel receipts can also be claimed. Productions may negotiate on the percentage of receipts paid, to take into account fuel used for personal / commuting purposes. If no car allowance is provided, mileage should be claimed at the HMRC rate (currently 45p per mile)
Source Notes: Allowance/kit rate, not labour rate.

Rate Text: A payment for any specialist computer software or licences that you are required to provide for your role. EG. Vectorworks, Creative Suite etc. Productions may pay this as monthly fee, calculated from the total cost of your software / subscriptions.
Source Notes: Allowance/kit rate, not labour rate.

Rate Text: If you provide computer equipment of high value, you should claim this allowance rather than the standard computer allowance rate. This rate is negotiable and should be based on the value of your equipment list.
